dashboard.label: TA-baseline Overview
dashboard.description: Collects a host security baseline from the kernel/filesystem: UEFI SecureBoot state, kernel lockdown mode, SSH root-login and password-auth settings (sshd_config, including

search.query: index=main sourcetype="baseline:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="baseline.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="baseline:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
